=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml; scripts/ai_labels.py:plan.yml 3479-3501, 3563-3566, 3581; ai_labels.py 37-41, 1139-1143, 1316-1319 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run edited .github/workflows/plan.yml and scripts/ai_labels.py. Neither file is in linked issue #8844's files_touched grant, and the edits ship unrelated P3a (fingerprint-breaker truthiness, check_run_url lookup) and P11a (180 s drain deadline) changes under the P8c PR.
  WHY: The commit-time scope guard (scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, already failing in the pre-push gate) rejects out-of-grant paths, or the unrelated behaviour lands without its own plan or review. Severity disagreement: gemini rated BLOCKER and the others MAJOR, so the highest (critical) is used. sonnet and glm also flag the off-task P3a/P11a fragment and README rows (SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED, RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED, ZOMBIE_RUN_*) added by the same run.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml; .github/workflows/plan.yml:clarify.yml:2348; plan.yml:3581 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the FP_JOB_ID jq expression, `capture("/check-runs/(?<id>[1-9][0-9]*)$")` is said to throw when check_run_url is missing, empty or non-matching. Because `//` does not catch errors, the `// .id` fallback would never run and the jq program would abort.
  WHY: FP_JOB_ID ends up empty, the annotations fetch is skipped, workflow_failure_heal.py reports `annotations_unavailable`, and no AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1 marker is written. Reviewers call this a regression pinned by the tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:10001-10016 / 10306-10317 smoke fixtures. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this finding. Its argument is that jq's capture/match yields no output, not an error, on a non-match, so `// .id` falls back correctly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check lines 18772-18776; _security_dependency_clear_latch lines 18791-18797; release call at line 24164 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The escalation branch adds ai:needs-human before it posts the latch comment. If the comment POST fails, the branch only warns, then still writes security_dependency_escalated_ts and logs reason=security_dependency_escalated.
  WHY: _security_dependency_clear_latch removes the label only when a trusted latch comment with reason=security_dependency_wait exists, and escalation is never retried. The orphaned ai:needs-human label is therefore never cleared on release. All four reviewers rated MAJOR (confidence 3-5).
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1103-1104, 1139-1145, 266-280, 34-41 (sync_ai_labels.yml:43) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The 180 s RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS is checked only at the top of each per-item loop iteration. It does not bound the initial `_list_open_items_with_label` listing or in-flight `_github_api_request` calls (3 attempts x 120 s timeout).
  WHY: Slow or failing requests can push the drain past the 5-minute sync_ai_labels.yml job timeout. The job is then killed before its errors/summary handling runs, which is the failure the deadline was meant to prevent. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rated MAJOR; glm rated NIT as a residual pathological case. The highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_extract_standalone_state_json_from_comments, lines 18589-18600 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `try (tonumber | floor) catch 0` silently turns non-numeric or null security_dependency_* state values into 0.
  WHY: Reviewers say this can restart the hold episode early or re-fire escalation from a malformed escalated_ts. Both rated MAJOR. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this (lines 18593-18596) as the documented, tested reset behaviour (test_security_hold_records_held_since_once_per_episode).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check, trusted-latch dedupe early `return 0` | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When a trusted latch marker already exists, the function returns without writing security_dependency_escalated_ts. This happens, for example, after an earlier state write failed silently via `|| true`. Every later tick then picks action=escalate again.
  WHY: Each tick repeats a paginated _security_dependency_complete_comments read for the rest of the hold. That contradicts the "steady state adds nothing beyond the verdict read" budget in agents.d/stuck-states-p8c-security-hold.md. Both rated NIT.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1229-1246 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A deadline trip and exhaustion of the 10-item cap both log `LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED reason=budget remaining=N`, with no separate reason for the time cap.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell from the log which limit deferred the drain, although agents.d/stuck-states-p11a-retired-label-drain.md describes the deadline as a separate trigger. Both rated NIT.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1143 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `break` on `_retired_label_drain_deadline` reuses the existing budget deferral path, so the deadline is reported as `reason=budget`.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell which limit stopped the drain. The reviewer calls this secondary to the out-of-scope finding: the hunk should leave this PR. Same root cause as the 1229-1246 entry, kept separate because the line ranges do not overlap or abut.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Implement security-dependency hold escalation after DEPENDENCY_WAIT_ESCALATE_DAYS and release on unmerged predecessor (linked issue #8844, Refs #8291, Local ID p8-security-hold); the out-of-grant last-run edits must be dropped.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, scripts/ai_labels.py, agents.d/stuck-states-p11a-retired-label-drain.md, agents.d/stuck-states-p3a-fingerprint-markers.md, changelog.d/stuck-states-p3a-fingerprint-markers.md, README.md (four non-P8c env-var rows)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The #8844 files_touched grant lists 12 files. The last_run diff touches plan.yml (P3a), ai_labels.py and the P11a fragment, the P3a fragments, and the README rows SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED, RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED, ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED and ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS, none of which are in the grant. The pre-push gate already reports tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py failing.
- requirement: Persist security_dependency_escalated_ts across poller ticks so the poller does not re-escalate an already-escalated hold and the steady-state API budget matches the agents.d description.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_security_dependency_hold_age_check` (trusted-latch dedupe branch)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: gemini finds no check that escalated_ts is safely persisted in the AI_STANDALONE_STALL_STATE_V1 comment, so a failed write may lead to redundant re-escalation. minimax says the function returns 0 on a trusted latch marker without persisting escalated_ts, so a silent `write_standalone_state_json` failure (`|| true`) re-runs the age evaluation and the paginated comments fetch. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reject this gap: sonnet says the label check and latch-marker check prevent a second post, and glm says tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:6370-6381 covers it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml, scripts/ai_labels.py:plan.yml lines 3484-3488 and 3581; scripts/ai_labels.py lines 37-41, 1142-1143, 1318-1319 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run edited plan.yml and ai_labels.py. Neither is in the #8844 files_touched grant or the PR changed-files list, and both are P3a/P11a follow-ups. The same run also edited the P3a/P11a fragments and added README rows for SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED, RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED and ZOMBIE_RUN_*.
  WHY: The scope guard (scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py) rejects the commit, or unrelated behaviour lands without review. The editor should revert these hunks.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check, escalate branch | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The label is added before the latch comment. A failed POST only warns, and escalated_ts is still recorded.
  WHY: The release paths (near lines 24164 and 24189) call _security_dependency_clear_latch, which needs the reason=security_dependency_wait comment. The label is never cleared and escalation is not retried.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check, trusted-latch dedupe `return 0` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The function returns without writing security_dependency_escalated_ts, so every tick picks action=escalate again.
  WHY: Each tick repeats a paginated _security_dependency_complete_comments read, which contradicts the agents.d steady-state budget. The fix is about 3 lines.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:line 1143 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A deadline break reports the same `LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED reason=budget` as the 10-item cap.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell which limit stopped the drain. Secondary to the out-of-scope finding; belongs in its own P11a change.
- NOTE: Rejected the pass-1 clarify.yml:2348 / plan.yml:3581 "capture() aborts jq" finding (capture yields nothing on a non-match, so `// .id` falls back). Also rejected the lines 18593-18596 `try (tonumber | floor) catch 0` finding as documented, tested reset behaviour.
- NOTE: Task gaps NONE; all #8844 deliverables are present. The pass-1 escalated_ts-persistence TASK_GAP is rejected. HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: post the latch comment before adding the label and return early on failure (6 lines); write escalated_ts before the dedupe `return 0` (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_security_dependency_hold_age_check | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The issue is labelled ai:needs-human before the latch comment is confirmed as posted.
  WHY: A failed POST only warns while escalated_ts is still written. The orphaned label blocks release cleanup because _security_dependency_clear_latch requires the latch comment.
